title: Chris Kelly's band and its written music
summary: Angrum liked working with trumpeter Chris Kelly, who insisted on music stands and used popular stock arrangements ordered from New York, including a march.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom
